en.title: The fury of water that overwhelms an entire bridge, swept away like a toy in the swollen river
en.summary: A bridge collapsed in Nepal's Budhi Gandaki river during flooding. The tributary region had previously experienced a severe glacier collapse disaster last August that killed over 1,400 people and left thousands missing.
